upsert.deadlineLabel: Entries must be received by midnight UK time on 31 Oct 2026; ends earlier if a winning entry arrives
upsert.eligibility: Open to everyone except residents of Belarus, Crimea, Cuba, Donetsk and Luhansk, Iran, Russia, Syria and North Korea, and anyone under export-control or sanctions restrictions. One entry per person; under-18s need guardian approval. Needs hardware security equipment.

prize.description: US$20,000 cash, one prize, to the first documented working method.
